entities.name: EPS bearer context modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure to modify an EPS bearer context with specific QoS and TFT, or re-negotiate header compression configuration associated to an EPS bearer context. Initiated by the network but may also be initiated as part of UE requested procedures.

entities.name: UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to request bearer resource allocation.

entities.name: UE requested bearer resource modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to request modification of bearer resources.

entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to request establishment of bearers for data transfer.

entities.name: Measurement Assistance Information
entities.description: Information element used to assist in measurement procedures.

entities.name: APN-AMBR
entities.description: Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate per APN, defining maximum bandwidth for all non-GBR bearers of a PDN connection.

entities.name: WLAN offload indication
entities.description: Indication for WLAN offload capability of a PDN connection.

entities.name: Session-AMBR
entities.description: Session Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate, defining maximum bandwidth for all non-GBR QoS flows of a PDU session.

entities.name: QoS rule(s)
entities.description: Rules defining QoS parameters for data flows.

entities.name: UUAA-SM procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UAS (Unmanned Aircraft System) services.

relations.description: EPS bearer context modification procedure may be initiated as part of UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure.
EPS bearer context modification procedure may be initiated as part of UE requested bearer resource modification procedure.
EPS bearer context modification procedure may be initiated to update Measurement Assistance Information.
EPS bearer context modification procedure may be initiated to update APN-AMBR of the UE.
EPS bearer context modification procedure may be initiated to update WLAN offload indication.
EPS bearer context modification procedure may be initiated to update session-AMBR for inter-system change.
EPS bearer context modification procedure may be initiated to update QoS rule(s) for inter-system change.
EPS bearer context modification procedure may be initiated together with completion of service request procedure.
EPS bearer context modification procedure may be initiated to trigger UUAA-SM procedure for UAS services.
